name: [Negative] App Performance & Stability Issues
description: Users report frequent crashes, freezes, and glitches that prevent them from using core features such as placing stop losses or editing orders. The app’s instability is consistently described as the worst experience, causing frustration and a perception that the app is unusable.

name: [Negative] App Stability & Functionality Issues
description: Users report that the app is consistently unresponsive, crashes, freezes, and provides no useful functionality, leading to frustration and abandonment.

name: [Negative] App Performance & Reliability Issues
description: Users report that the app frequently fails to launch, crashes during use, and suffers from sluggish performance, causing delays in key actions such as account opening and withdrawals.

name: [Negative] App Crashes
description: Users repeatedly report that the app fails to launch, crashes immediately upon opening, or displays a blank screen, preventing them from accessing any features.

name: [Negative] App Crashes & Installs
description: Users report that the application fails to launch, crashes, or does not install on devices, often after updates, causing frustration and inability to use core functionality.
